summary:
帕羅奧圖網路EPS大幅超預期9.94%，平台化動能延續但估值仍偏貴。
• EPS 1.03美元，大幅超越預期0.94美元，正向驚喜9.94%
• 營收25.9億美元，規模持續放大
• 次世代安全平台滲透率提升帶動經常性收入
• 獲利率改善反映營運槓桿逐步發酵
ai_view:
訊號正向：近10%的EPS超標凸顯平台化策略帶來的營運槓桿與經常性收入成長。短期市場情緒偏多，但極端評價使股價對任何指引微調都高度敏感。中期關鍵在於平台客戶留存與交叉銷售深化能否支撐高估值。追蹤指標：NGS年化營收增速、RPO、淨收入留存率、毛利與自由現金流利潤率，以及管理層對全年訂單成長的指引。

需留意：營收年增資料缺失，成長斜率須由其他季度佐證；本益比246.79極高，容錯空間極小；競爭者降價與整合併購可能稀釋市佔

summary_en:
Palo Alto Networks beat EPS by 9.94%, sustaining platform momentum though valuation stays rich.
• EPS of $1.03 strongly beat the $0.94 estimate, a 9.94% positive surprise
• Revenue of $2.59B continued to scale
• Rising next-gen security platform adoption boosts recurring revenue
• Margin improvement reflects emerging operating leverage

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: a near-10% EPS beat highlights operating leverage and recurring-revenue growth from the platform strategy. Near-term sentiment skews bullish, but the extreme valuation leaves the stock highly sensitive to even minor guidance tweaks. Mid-term, the key is whether platform retention and deeper cross-sell can support the rich multiple. Track: next-gen security ARR growth, RPO, net revenue retention, gross and free-cash-flow margins, and management guidance on full-year bookings growth.

Watch：Missing revenue YoY means the growth slope needs corroboration from other quarters; P/E of 246.79 leaves an extremely thin margin for error; Competitor price cuts and M&A could dilute share
